signal: Alianza completed its acquisition of Metaswitch from Microsoft, growing to more than 1,000 service-provider customers including 19 of the top 20 global operators

email.body1:
Jonathan, saw Alianza closed the Metaswitch acquisition, now more than 1,000 service providers, including 19 of the top 20 operators.

Folding in that base usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before signals go stale, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Alianza off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jonathan, quick follow-up for Alianza.

After a deal like Metaswitch, growth expectations tend to outpace what headcount can cover, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late, then it's a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alianza needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jonathan, last bit of proof for Alianza.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alianza's reply rate likely compares to other communications software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jonathan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating Metaswitch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your growth motion? I'll tailor it to Alianza either way.
